Light: NIGHT.
CHAPTER 2.2 — OLD FRIENDS (NORMAL). Dug-in bunker reported on high ground, grid bearing ~0200 mils. The effect bands are tight — put it on the roof.
Chapter requirement: locate the target by SHIFT FROM A KNOWN POINT — a grid call caps this chapter at 2★.
Par time for full stars: 6:00.
MET: wind from 1000 mils at 6 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 244 553, ground elev 265 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "DERBY" grid 231 550 (grid brg 4530) · AB1002 "ICEBOX" grid 225 560 (grid brg 5127). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages NGOMOPA and NOPA and RAMOVA — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
